Ep. 51 - The Softer Side of 70s Rock

podcast.body: This was the very first single released by the revamped Fleetwood Mac from their 1975 "White Album." Written and sung by Christine McVie, it became their first Top 20 hit in the United States and is about a relationship on the rocks. "Christine McBeat wrote and sang the lead vocal on the very first single that the revamped Fleetwood Mac released from the 1975 album that's come to be called the White Album. And it was their first top 20 hit in the United States, like so many of the band songs it is about a relationship on the rocks."
